finding.comment: the never-rejected claim is scoped to the JSON API while the 100 MB rule belongs to the separate upload service; scopes do not overlap, so this is not a contradiction

files.patch:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/docs/api-limits.md
@@ -0,0 +1,9 @@
+# Request limits
+
+JSON API requests are never rejected for size.
+
+## Uploads
+
+Uploads larger than 100 MB are rejected with 413 by the separate
+upload service.

rationale: scope-distinct claims (JSON API vs upload service)
